g.text: Block budget and sampling: complete five-fold test comparisons
Controlled comparison series, shared training-only API vocabulary within each split. Points are pooled five-split test metrics, mean +/- sample SD across three seeds.
Only M1/M2 have complete local curves at every cap. M3 is omitted because its returned comparisons do not cover all caps/samplers and five splits.
The highest standard configuration here is M2 / signal750: 85.80% accuracy. This is separate from the original-primary signal500 series in Figure 1.
